judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete, stopping partway through its own Definition of Done. Functionally, it fails to resolve and validate against dynamic schemas returned by function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource`s per call, instead compiling the schema only once at registration time. It also misses the required one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`, omits property paths from the validation failure log line, and leaves behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` artifact and an extra `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than placing tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as specified. Finally, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were made, and several acceptance criteria tests are missing.
